detailed_descriptions_html.en:
The Rent Expansion introduces property management to ContractVille.

Step directly inside your investments and take control of real estate across the town! A total of 18 distinct apartments across various city buildings are available to acquire, with the ability to manage up to 4 properties at a time. Plus, the houses you build can now be put up for rent as well! Fully furnish, decorate, and list your properties on the market with flexible 1, 4, or 7-day lease terms to secure steady cash flow.

Being a landlord comes with real risks! It isn't just about collecting rent—some tenants will treat your place nicely, while others might leave trash all over the floor, smudge up your freshly cleaned windows, or even walk away with your furniture. The rental properties of ContractVille are ready for their new landlord. Start building your empire today!

Expansion Features

This expansion adds new properties and mechanics for renting:

  • 18 Rentable Apartments: Spread across 9 distinct buildings throughout the city, these properties are ready to be purchased, designed, and listed on the rental market.

  • Land Development: Purchase empty plots, use your planner to build houses from scratch, and put them on the rental market.

  • Rental Income: Earn regular payments by renting out your decorated apartments and land properties to tenants.

  • Interior Design: Freely decorate and furnish the empty apartments before renting them out.

Instead of only completing contracts for clients, you can now invest in your own properties. Buy apartment buildings available in different tiers, from basic to luxury, or purchase empty land to build custom houses. Once your property is ready, you can design the interiors and rent them out to tenants for a steady income.

Key Features

  • Brand New Renting Mechanic: Buy, furnish, and rent out properties.

  • 9 Apartment Buildings: Includes 3 Basic, 3 Medium, and 3 Luxury buildings.

  • 18 Apartments in Total: 2 apartments per building.

  • Build and Rent: Construct houses on empty land parcels and rent them out.

  • Income Management: Balance your building and renovation costs with your rental income.
